payload.title: Hooks: write stdin on a helper thread and drain stderr concurrently so the timeout fires
payload.description: From kbs-bbf2a6. hooks.rs writes the payload to the hook child's stdin before the timeout loop starts and drains stderr only after exit, so a hook that never reads stdin (or fills stderr) hangs kbs forever. Write stdin on a helper thread, drain stdout and stderr concurrently, and enforce the timeout in both runtimes. Acceptance: a hook that never reads stdin is killed at its timeout (scenario in both runtimes).
